notes.title: Patch 1.7.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356106/9d50325706b5f8e3dfc718fa2f9e000302bc1be1.png[/img]

This is a small patch aimed primarily to allow PS4/PS5 players to enjoy Arcadegeddon without a paid online subscription. 
In addition, we've also included a few minor fixes/changes to this patch. 

There will be more news and updates coming soon for Arcadegeddon!

- Added FSR 2.2 support for consoles 
- Users can purchase now ArCoins directly from the Customization Lockers
- Fixed an issue where Pandemonium was not rewarding weapon qualities based on difficulty level
- Fixed an issue where purchasing certain tints could cause the player to lose input
- Fixed an issue where certain weapons could exceed their maximum quality level

notes.title: Arcadegeddon F2P Update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Q7SfmjfZ0rA;full][/previewyoutube]

We're so excited to welcome even more players to Gilly's Arcade with our Free to Play update. Sharing this chaotic roguelike shooter with fans over the past several years has been an awesome experience and now it's easier than ever to rally the squad.

We’ve introduced new weapons, new cosmetics, meaningful gameplay adjustments, and so much more in our latest update. We hope new and returning players find plenty of excuses to chase that undeniable ‘just one more run’ feeling.

To everyone joining us in the arcade - thanks so much for your support! We can’t wait for you all to share your rad looks, impressive high scores, destructive builds, and thoughtful feedback.

Much Love,
The IllFonic Crew

[list]
[*] Rebalanced Tickets/ArCoin gain and costs to be more consistent with item rarities and game progression
[*] Updated Daily/Weekly Challenges
[*] Improved loot drops and wave variety in Horde Mode
[*] Two new weapons (Cyber Katana and Firecracker)
[*] New Cosmetics
[*] Ammo QoL changes and fixes
[*] Power Token rebalance
[*] Crash Fixes
[*] And more!
[/list]

As a token of our appreciation, all supporters who've purchased and played Arcadegeddon before 3/18 will receive an exclusive cosmetic item, the Hazard Suit, and instant starter weapon access to the two new weapons, Cyber Katana and Firecracker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356106/9e34b63268506ab260412685f7b39207911fb1f3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356106/7ecee8e174d484955252d895e6f78751d88940a3.jpg[/img]

Patch 1.3.2 is now available! 
Restart your client to download the latest patch.

In Patch 1.3.2, we've included a few fixes and changes to address issues that were able to fit into this patch. Account Linking is also now available for Steam users! We're still working on some cool things for the next big update, so stay tuned for more info!

[h2][b]Account Linking on Steam is now enabled[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Steam users are now able to play cross-platform with all other platforms after linking with Epic Games.
[*] Follow instructions to link your Epic account to your Steam account [url=https://www.epicgames.com/help/en-US/epic-accounts-c5719348850459/connect-accounts-c5719351300507/how-do-i-add-my-friends-from-my-steam-account-to-my-epic-games-account-a5720333787291]here[/url]
[/list]
[b]Party Management System[/b]
[list]
[*] The Party Management system allows you to host and join lobbies using party codes [u][b]without[/b][/u] having to be friends on Steam or Epic.
[*] This feature is currently only available for Steam users and Epic Games users. 
[*] To find this feature, navigate to the “Friends” tab
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356106/1f9c7b34fe705c322ebf697ef775f24083000905.png[/img]

[list]
[*] To host a game, the host player must be in Gilly’s. Navigate to your Friends tab and click on the Party Management button at the bottom of your screen.
[*] Scroll to the right and select Public to generate a code to send
[*] Switching off of public or exiting and re-entering Gilly’s will [u][b]reset[/b][/u] this code
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356106/a5998f16a47b546338e3086312b539b0a18b99dd.png[/img]

[list]
[*] To join a lobby
[*] Navigate to the “Friends” tab
[*] Set privacy settings to “Friends Only” or “Invite Only” 
[*] Enter a provided code 
[*] Join and have fun!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356106/4a2ffa0f4015582a715c55d4fdd80cd441261088.png[/img]

[h2][b]Fixes and Changes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Addressed an issue where enemies could spawn or fall out of the map in Horde Mode
[i]If you experience this issue, please let us know in our Discord under the Bugs thread![/i]
[*] Addressed an issue where party members queueing for matchmaking would sometimes not load in, or load in as a spectator
[*] Fixed an issue where users could not link their accounts to Epic Games if they had unlinked after having previously been linked.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could sometimes lose controller input after exiting the hack terminal
[*] Fixed an issue Rocketeer troopers were not firing against players properly at short ranges
[i]Rocketeer troopers should now distance themselves or engage against players properly in close-quarters [/i]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain cosmetics were preventing players from taking damage
[*] Fixed an issue where party member Steam profile avatars would sometimes not load Gilly’s
[*] Localization fixes
[*] Various Chinese, Spanish, French localization improvements and fixes
[*] Adjusted various UI elements and localization issues in other languages [/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0 - Steam Release
notes.content:
[u][h1][b]Arcadegeddon Patch 1.3.0[/b][/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356106/41578c9a24bb4e963f06fe3dbdd3d85f245d6afe.png[/img]
[u][b][h2]Arcadegeddon Now On Steam![/h2][/b][/u]
Rise To Action with Arcadegeddon On STEAM
Base Game and Deluxe Upgrade Available Today. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cnk3sn6iwLY

[u][h2][b]Time Trials[/b][/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356106/f04b5f4fa8d31ac0c15506b7b276ba0e859d2695.png[/img]
Time Trials are now playable on Arcadegeddon!
In the Time Trial game mode, you will have 30 minutes to beat all 4 bosses.
Better start practicing your speedrunning so you can get the best time and score possible!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LmhL98Kwbto

[u][h2][b]Horde Mode Update[/b][/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356106/f2c6d01ccb1727f4ef3d7385ce1c6f9d3a77e5bd.png[/img]
Horde Mode has been updated with a new intro cinematic and 2 new Horde Mode arenas!

[list]
[*] Horde Mode Aftermath
[*] Horde Mode Downtown
[/list]
[u][h2]New Cosmetics[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356106/81f56a10898126f008fff51e053d62a9aed5159a.png[/img]
We have a variety of new cosmetics and updates to existing cosmetics that are now available with patch 1.3.0!

If you’re feeling like you need to make some changes to your wardrobe, this is the time to do it!
[list]
[*] 7 New Hairstyles
[*] 6 New Outfits
[*] 8 New Head Accessories
[*] New Tints!
[*] New Slugger Model
[/list]

[u][h2][b]Boss Stagger Bar[/b][/h2][/u]
Bosses now have a Stagger Bar that, when filled, will cause the boss to be temporarily stunned and take additional damage for the duration.
[u][h2][b]UI Updates[/b][/h2][/u]
With this new patch, we wanted to make some QoL UI fixes and changes to ensure that you all have the best Arcadegeddon experience possible!

[list]
[*] Horde Mode UI has been updated with some new UI elements for information about the “waves”
[*] Defend the Exploit will now show the Health Bar on the top of your screen
[*] Surge Abilities have been updated to show when they are fully charged
[*] Boss Portals now have an HP bar
[/list]
[u][h2][b]General[/b][/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] Surge Energy has been rebalanced for late game
[*] EXP from Elemental weapon status effects have been rebalanced
[*] Acid weapons slightly nerfed
[*] Infernal weapons now no longer instantly apply the ignite affect. Enemies are now ignited after the initial fire explosion has occurred. 
[*] Hacks now have diminishing currency returns when sold to the vendor.
[*] Buffed chests loot
[*] Chests now grant Surge Energy
[*] Boss chests and certain chests in Horde Mode now grant Unique weapon ammo
[*] Fixed an issue where bosses would not use certain abilities
[/list]
